source.basis: Mechanical principle and dimensional values supplied by the user; independently implemented here

polyomino_cavity: Continuous sharp inset outline formed from owned row runs and shared-row bridges, not per-cell blind holes
tube_engagement: Male stems fit OUTSIDE tubes, between tubes/posts and perimeter walls; tube bores stay open through roof ribs
fit_variables: Male diameter correction and female RADIAL clearance are independent
native_colors: Explicit logical ColorId and editable native DisplayColorRGB; no GUI renderer was run
editing: Edit each Parameters_* node. BodyHeight, dimensions, male diameter correction, and female radial clearance drive native expressions.
Topology and stud masks are fixed per type. Select another archetype or regenerate the plan to change owned cells.
Export only the named final solid, not the hidden construction tree. Trial print layout has exactly nine listed parts.
Retest the native assembly contract after edits; the saved figures are nominal placements, not a physical fit approval.
verification: Actual BRep validity/sections/COM, native insertion/bearing, separate-process moved-copy reopening, dimension edits and mesh manifold validation

tessellation.meaning: Digital mesh fidelity only; NOT a printed tolerance or physical fit claim
